# Volta Spark Cleaning Services

> Professional cleaning services for homes, offices, short lets and post-construction spaces across Lagos, Nigeria.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://voltasparkcleaning.vercel.app/): Service information, company standards and contact details.
- [Book a cleaning](https://voltasparkcleaning.vercel.app/booking): Prepare a cleaning request and continue to WhatsApp.

## Services

- Home cleaning
- Deep cleaning
- Office and commercial cleaning
- Post-construction cleaning
- Move-in and move-out cleaning
- Event and short-let resets
